footerNotes.consentBody: By entrusting HelloVerify with your personal information through this website, you expressly consent to the processing of your data for lead generation purposes — empowering us to deliver timely, relevant updates, thoughtfully curated offers and meaningful communications about the products and services designed to serve you best. Flowing & Engaging Whether it's your nanny, house staff, driver, or tenant — every person in your home can be verified quickly, accurately and entirely digitally. No paperwork. No delays. Just complete peace of mind.
footerNotes.dataUsageBody: The personal information you provide will be used exclusively for lead generation purposes, including the delivery of thoughtfully curated marketing communications about our products and services. HelloVerify is firmly committed to your privacy — your data will never be used for any purpose beyond what you have explicitly consented to. For a comprehensive understanding of how we handle, protect and respect your personal data, we invite you to review our [Privacy Policy], which fully outlines our data protection practices and your rights.
